findings.title: Forced mode bypass
findings.challengeReason: Header presence bypasses the mode check.
findings.impact: An authenticated caller bypasses an operational control.
findings.remediation: Authorize the override and validate one canonical value.

findings.title: Order lookup lacks ownership
findings.challengeReason: The lookup accepts an arbitrary order identifier.
findings.traceEvidence: Runtime gateway policy is outside this repository.
findings.impact: A caller may access another account's order.
findings.remediation: Enforce ownership at the lookup boundary.
findings.dynamicTest: GET /orders/other-account-order with a normal user token

findings.title: Report query interpolation
findings.challengeReason: The value uses a parameterized query.

findings.title: Archive lookup exposure
findings.challengeReason: The repository method lacks ownership enforcement.
findings.traceEvidence: No external route calls the archive method.

findings.title: Deployment policy unknown
findings.challengeReason: The enforcing deployment policy is absent.
